newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil court due to rule on telecom sell-off.
newsitem.headline: Brazil court due to rule on telecom sell-off.

text.p: Brazil's highest court was due to judge Wednesday the constitutionality of a law laying out the framework for the deregulation of the telecommunications sector, a spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said the Supreme Federal Tribunal would meet at 1330 local time/1630 GMT but that the session's order of business had not yet been fixed.

The ruling, which has been put off at least twice by the court in the past two weeks, could affect the upcoming multi-billion dollar auction of cellular telephone Band B concessions. Bids for 10 concession areas are due in by April 7.
It could also seriously delay government plans to open the country's telecommunications sector to private competition.
